# J K Fertilizers

> J K Fertilizers is a B2B manufacturer of organic fertilizers, base granules, and coated granules in Anand, Gujarat, India. Specializing in FCO-approved Organic Manure, PROM, PDM, and Mycorrhiza granules since 2006.

## Organic Fertilizer & Base Granule Products

- [PROM (Phosphate Rich Organic Manure)](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/prom): FCO-approved bio-phosphate (min. 10.4% P2O5, min. 7.9% Organic Carbon) replacing chemical DAP and SSP via organic-acid phosphorus solubilization.
- [PDM (Potash Derived from Molasses)](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/pdm): FCO-approved chloride-safe bio-potassium (min. 14.5% K2O, min. 16.0% Organic Carbon) from sugarcane spent wash to elevate fruit brix and prevent MOP chloride burn.
- [Organic Manure](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/organic-manure): FCO-certified thermophilic organic compost (min. 16.0% Organic Carbon, C:N < 20:1) to restore soil humus and Cation Exchange Capacity (CEC).
- [Mycorrhiza Biofertilizer](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/mycorrhiza-granules-biofertilizers): FCO-certified VAM endo-mycorrhizae (min. 100 IP/gm Glomus spp.) expanding root absorptive surface area by up to 700%.
- [Diatomite Silicon](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/diatomite-silicon): FCO-certified biogenic amorphous silica (SiO2·nH2O) releasing soluble orthosilicic acid (H4SiO4) for plant cell wall armor and lodging resistance.
- [Plant Available Silica](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/plant-available-silica): High-solubility monosilicic acid (H4SiO4) base granules for anti-lodging and thermal transpiration defense.
- [Coated Base Granules Bio NPK](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/coated-base-granules-bio-npk): Mineral core coated with active Azotobacter, PSB, and KMB bacterial consortium (>10^7 CFU/g).
- [Coated Base Granules Mycorrhiza](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/coated-base-granules-mycorrhiza): Mineral carrier encapsulated with viable endo-mycorrhizal spores (min. 60–100 IP/gm).
- [Humic Based Granules](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/humic-based-granules): Potassium Humate and Fulvate granules with high carboxyl/phenolic density for micronutrient chelation and root branching.
- [Organic Carbon Base Granules](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/organic-carbon-base-granules): High bio-carbon carrier (min. 18.0% SOC) feeding rhizosphere microflora and absorbing liquid bio-coatings.
- [Pancharatna Base Granules](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/pancharatna-base-granules): 5-in-1 multi-mineral granule co-granulating Calcium, Magnesium, Sulfur, Silicon, and Organic Carbon.
- [Base Granules](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/base-granules): Universal high-hardness mineral carrier (>4.0 kg crush strength) engineered from Gypsum and Dolomite to replace swelling bentonite.
- [Customized Base Granules](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/customized-base-granules): Tailored mineral carrier recipes calibrated to client bulk density (0.95–1.35 g/cm³) and pH targets.
- [Customized Coated Granules](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/customized-coated-granules): Turnkey low-temperature drum coating service (<38°C) for bio-fertilizers, humics, seaweed, and micronutrients.
- [Enriched Base Granules](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/enriched-base-granules): Mineral core fortified with secondary Calcium, Magnesium, Sulfur, and Zinc throughout the particle volume.
- [Other Nutrients Base Granules](https://jkfertilizers.com/products/other-nutrients-base-granules): Micronutrient-fortified carrier integrating Zn, B, Fe, Mn, and S directly into the core to eliminate dry blend segregation.

## Manufacturing Services

- [Granule Technology](https://jkfertilizers.com/services/granule-technology): High-precision granulation engineering, rotary drum granulators, and uniform particle sizing.
- [Infrastructure Leasing](https://jkfertilizers.com/services/infrastructure-leasing): ISO-certified manufacturing capacity leasing for expanding agri-input brands.
- [Custom Packaging Solutions](https://jkfertilizers.com/services/custom-packaging-solutions): Complete private label packaging, automated bagging, and moisture-proof packing.
- [Job Work Services](https://jkfertilizers.com/services/job-work-services): Contract fertilizer manufacturing with strict quality assurance and high throughput.
- [Warehouse & Storage](https://jkfertilizers.com/services/warehouse-storage): Large-capacity covered storage, inventory management, and pan-India dispatch logistics.
